THE CARTOGRAPHER'S DOSSIER

Aged nautical chart for the player. Brass compass, wax seals, rubber stamps that slam, torn paper hints.

Sound is synthesised in the page — nothing to download. Tap the seal, the button, the hint strips.

Left to right is the player's whole journey.

3D lives in the real transforms: the compass ring is tilted on a rotateX plane, this card physically flips on its Y axis, the wax seal splits into two halves.

Hit the replay button to see the whole unlock beat again.

COMMAND — the organiser's side

The hunt graph is a literal corkboard: index cards on pins, red string for edges, a gate card where the branch opens. Click any card to load it into the editor on the right.

Race Control is the war room — the map is a chart table tilted in 3D, with live crew blips on it. Try the pause button.

Names, crews and clue text are sample copy, not real event data.
